statement.scope: finite discrete spaces compatible with the source semi-filter/preservation definitions; not claimed for graph row/column generator geometry
statement.family: For m>=3 let U=[m], Γ=U∪{w}, A={w}, generators B_i=(U\{i})∪{w}, D_i=U\{i}, and C_j=U\{1,...,j}. Let Λ_old={(C_j,D_{j+1}): 2<=j<=m-1}. Add p=(D_1,D_2).
statement.claim: The least upward-closed family above w preserving Λ_old has exactly {U,D_1,...,D_m}, excludes empty, and all old rules are dormant. After adding p, preservation forces C_2,C_3,...,C_m=empty in sequence. Consequently the least closure becomes P(U), its cardinality jumps from m+1 to 2^m, and at least m-1 intersection-rule conclusions become newly forced.
statement.method_consequence: Raw closure cardinality, log closure cardinality, raw newly-forced-intersection count, and raw propagation depth cannot be universal O(1)-marginal per-new-pair potentials over all source-compatible finite discrete spaces.

proof_plan: Above w requires every D_i because w belongs to every B_i.
Upward closure of all co-singletons D_i contains only U and the D_i.
For j>=2, C_j has size <=m-2 and is a proper subset of each relevant co-singleton, so C_j is absent initially; Λ_old is therefore preserved vacuously.
Inductively, if C_j is forced then old pair (C_j,D_{j+1}) forces C_{j+1}=C_j∩D_{j+1}.
At j=m-1 this forces C_m=empty. Upward closure of empty is all P(U).

frozen_predictions.statement: Before p, least closure has cardinality m+1 and excludes empty for every m>=3.
Before p, no old rule fires because C_2 is absent.
After p, the forced intersection chain has m-1 conclusions C_2,...,C_m and ends at empty.
After p, least closure cardinality is 2^m.
The one-pair marginal jump in raw closure cardinality and raw propagation count is unbounded with m.

frozen_falsifiers.condition: For any tested m>=3, old closure contains empty or has cardinality other than m+1.
Any old rule fires before p.
After p, some C_j in the claimed chain is not forced.
After p, empty is not forced or closure cardinality is not 2^m.
The construction violates the source definitions of semi-filter, above-w base requirements, or preservation pairs.

non_claims: no super-log graph cover lower bound
no novelty claim for Horn/closure cascades
no claim that every closure-aware potential fails
no claim that the cascade family is realizable by row/column generators of an explicit graph
no claim that quotient/amortized charges cannot have O(1) marginal cost
